what: Northern Trust provides asset servicing to institutions, wealth management to wealthy families, and asset management. It is one of three large American custody banks and the one most focused on private wealth.
customers: Pension funds, sovereign wealth funds, asset managers, family offices and high-net-worth individuals.
money: custody, fund administration and related services
private banking and family office services
moat: Multi-generational relationships with wealthy families and custody mandates that are rarely moved because transferring assets is slow and risky.
risks: Fee revenue falls when markets fall
Custody pricing is under constant competitive pressure
opportunities: Wealth management is a higher-margin business than custody and it has unusual depth there
Cost discipline programmes have improved the efficiency ratio
Buybacks and a consistent dividend return most earnings
watch: Trust fee growth and the expense-to-revenue ratio.
